11:
Signs of a [kosher] locust:

Whatever has four legs.
It has four wings.
Its wings cover most of the length and circumference of its body.
And it has two hind legs to leap (meaning to jump and move from place to place), even if it does not currently have them and will grow them later.

Even if it has all of these signs, it is not permitted unless it is called a "locust" or there is a tradition that they are called "locusts."
Locusts do not require ritual slaughter.
The excrement of impure locusts is permissible.
